transcript:
AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help?
USER: Hi, I'm Rohan. We have a 3BHK in Kothrud, about 1400 sq ft, and want the full interiors done.
AGENT: Lovely. When do you get possession, and when would you like it done?
USER: We already have the keys. We'd like it finished by March.
AGENT: Are you the one making the decision on this?
USER: Yes, it's my flat. My wife and I decide together and she's on board.
AGENT: How did you hear about us?
USER: A friend's flat you did in Baner.
AGENT: I can offer Thursday 11am or Friday 4pm for a consultation.
USER: Thursday 11 works.

AGENT: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.
USER: I have a 2BHK in Wakad, how much would it cost?
AGENT: Your designer will walk you through pricing on the consultation, because it depends on your site and choices. What are you looking to get done?
USER: Full redesign, kitchen, wardrobes, living room and both bedrooms. 950 sq ft.
AGENT: And your timeline?
USER: We want to start design in October and move in in November. But roughly what per square foot do you charge?
AGENT: The designer will cover pricing properly on the consultation. Are you the decision-maker?
USER: Yes. I found you on Instagram. Book it.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: Hello, I want to set up a home office in my bungalow in Nashik. Full design and execution.
AGENT: Thank you. Is the property in Nashik itself?
USER: Yes, Gangapur Road, Nashik.
AGENT: I'm sorry, we only work in Pune city and PCMC because that's where our vendor network is.
USER: Oh, okay. Thanks.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: Hi, I just moved into a flat in Aundh. I'm looking for some ideas on colours and how to arrange my furniture. Can someone come and advise?
AGENT: Are you looking for a redesign with execution, or advice only?
USER: Just ideas really. I'll do the work myself with a local painter.
AGENT: Thanks for explaining. Our minimum engagement is a room redesign with execution, so we may not be the right fit for advice only.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: We want our living room and kitchen redone in our Viman Nagar flat before Diwali. Guests are coming.
AGENT: When is that from today?
USER: About three weeks.
AGENT: Design alone usually takes three to four weeks, and we can't take on projects that must be ready in under six weeks.
USER: It has to be before Diwali, no flexibility.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: I'm already your client, Mrs Kulkarni, Baner project. My designer hasn't replied for five days and the carpenters have stopped. This is really unacceptable.
AGENT: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll take a message and the team will call you back first thing.
USER: Please make sure someone actually calls.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: I have a 1BHK in Kharadi and want the whole flat done, kitchen, wardrobe, everything.
AGENT: Lovely. When would you like to start?
USER: Next month. My budget is about 1 to 1.5 lakh for the whole thing.
AGENT: Thank you for telling me. Honestly, that's likely below what a full flat with execution costs with us.
USER: Oh. That's all I have.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: I'm Priya. I rent a 2BHK in Baner on a three-year lease. I want to redo the living room and bedroom properly, furniture, lighting, finishes. No walls moved.
AGENT: Are you the decision-maker, and does the landlord allow it?
USER: Yes, I decide and the landlord's fine with no structural changes.
AGENT: Timeline?
USER: Sometime in the next three months.
AGENT: I can offer Monday 3pm or Tuesday 12pm.
USER: Monday 3pm.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: I'm calling for my parents. They've bought a 3BHK in Hadapsar and want full interiors.
AGENT: When do they get possession?
USER: In December, and they'd like to move in by April.
AGENT: Will your parents be making the decision, and can they attend the consultation?
USER: Yes, they decide and they've asked me to set it up. They'll both come.
AGENT: I can offer Saturday 11am or Sunday 5pm.
USER: Saturday 11 please.

AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling Aangan Studio.
USER: We're opening a restaurant in Koregaon Park, about 2000 sq ft, and need full interiors.
AGENT: Thank you. We design homes and small offices, and don't take on restaurants, hotels or retail.
USER: Okay, do you know anyone who does?
